# Ignacio Alonso Delgado

> Chief Enterprise Architect at Kyndryl and Associate Professor. Writes and speaks about cloud and enterprise architecture, AI agents and open-weight LLMs on-premises (NeoCloud), data science and big data, NLP, careers and roles in data, and social media. Articles are in Spanish and English.

## Main pages
- [Notes](https://ialonso.es/notes/): articles, talks, videos and expert opinions, filterable by topic and source
- [Bio](https://ialonso.es/bio/): career, key projects, skills and teaching
- [Experiments](https://ialonso.es/experiments/): public experiments and projects
- [Home](https://ialonso.es/): short introduction and current challenges
